status: decisions only; syscall implementation and validation pending
source_provenance: Source head is the supplied origin of the approved binary digest, not inferred from executable bytes.
identity_steps: Future OS adapter creates anonymous memfd with CLOEXEC and ALLOW_SEALING. Copy at most 32 MiB from an already opened source under launch deadline; reject empty/oversized image and every syscall failure.
Apply F_SEAL_WRITE|F_SEAL_GROW|F_SEAL_SHRINK|F_SEAL_SEAL, read back seals, then SHA256 the sealed bytes with sha2. Compare against the fixed approved digest. No hash subprocess or handwritten SHA.

Execute that same sealed fd with execveat(fd, empty path, argv, envp, AT_EMPTY_PATH). No pathname fallback or hash(path) identity claim. Scripts/interpreters are outside the fixed worker image profile.
Current inspect_image_candidate only hashes a memory slice. Even a match returns RequiresSealedFdAndOsLauncher; it never supplies a binding or execution permission.
fd_plan: Create distinct CLOEXEC pipes; move every internal fd above 2 in parent before fork to avoid fd 0/1/2 collisions.
Only parent-owned stdin write/stdout read/stderr read/exec-status read endpoints become O_NONBLOCK. Child pipe ends remain blocking.
Prepare argv, envp and all fd decisions before fork. Child path must have no allocation, Rust formatting, panic, locks, filesystem enumeration or destructors.

Review exact child syscall path before implementation: dup2 owned ends to 0/1/2, close unwanted descriptors with a bounded and audited strategy, preserve sealed image and CLOEXEC exec-status writer until exec, then execveat. Report errno as four bytes with a reviewed bounded failure path and _exit.
Child exec-status EOF alone does not prove image execution: combine launch protocol, identity chain, actual wait status and raw worker evidence. Partial errno is failure.

Inherited-fd closure including unrelated descriptors, closed standard fds, close_range policy/kernel/LSM behavior and exec-status inheritance require direct child fixtures. No fallback that leaks fds.
signal_plan: Future adapter must handle parent SIGPIPE without process-global surprises, preserve/restore signal state, and restore intended child mask/dispositions before exec. Exact pthread_sigmask/sigtimedwait and child syscall path remains unimplemented; no blocking reader thread or detached helper.
loader_trust: Clear inherited environment including LD_*, PATH and user runtime configuration. A sealed ELF image does not seal its dynamic interpreter, shared libraries, system loader cache or system preload configuration; these remain trusted host inputs and must be recorded. No sandbox or general containment guarantee.
failure_policy: seccomp/LSM/memfd/execveat/seal rejection is fail closed. No OS/cgroup/security setting changes or alternative pathname launch.
containment: Only the fixed worker documented as not creating children is in scope. Process group signaling is not proof that escaped descendants are absent. General containment and escaped-child tests remain unverified.

references.basis: Anonymous fd, CLOEXEC and sealing opt-in semantics.
AT_EMPTY_PATH executes by fd; CLOEXEC interpreter caveat.
Async-signal-safe boundary; does not by itself certify a Rust post-fork implementation.
